_provenance: Hand-authored by a Claude subagent from the pilot prose alone, blind to any translator output, 2026-09-23.

rules.condition: Is self's hp below 25% of max hp?

criteria.true: recall now, no matter how close the kill looked, a dead assassin secures nothing

rules.condition: Is my chosen target (the isolated enemy, or the clearly softest one) within Staccato's short range, with Staccato off cooldown?

criteria.true: in range of the picked target — stab it, every time it's off cooldown, on that same target
criteria.false: chosen target not in range yet, or Staccato still cooling down

rules.condition: Is my chosen isolated/softest target about to get away, or is this the decisive commit moment, with Solo off cooldown?

criteria.true: close the distance or make the decisive engage — it's not free, so only now
criteria.false: no urgency yet; don't burn Solo just because it's up

rules.condition: Are two or more enemy bearbots visible, grouped together, with none clearly isolated or clearly the softest?

criteria.true: a violin that trades evenly with a whole team has already failed — wait at the edge of vision
criteria.false: a valid pick exists, or nothing is grouped against me
